domain_handoffs.owner: Battle Map / Scene Builder design standards

map_authoring_authority.uploaded_image_asset: asset/media owner; PPIA-08 stores authorized stable reference and Scene association
map_authoring_authority.combat_movement_los_cover: owning tactical/action rules, not inferred by PPIA-08 foundation

blocking_guardrails: Uploaded map pixels are never destructively changed merely to align a grid.
Grid translation for calibration is not confused with viewport/camera pan.
A placement never becomes ownership of the referenced source Definition.
Hidden placement existence never leaks through counts, labels, search, errors, exports, diagnostics, notifications or AI context.
Launch snapshots pin map/calibration/placement versions; later edits do not silently rewrite active Session meaning.
Dungeon geometry does not invent collision, cover, LOS, damage, movement or balance rules.
Every required map workflow has a semantic nonvisual equivalent.
AI suggestions remain proposals until governed acceptance.
No foundation work activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, testers, paid services or production credentials.
